title: checkpoint-recovery-consistency
summary: Assess distributed checkpoint recovery using DLRover shared-memory readiness and step agreement, and NVIDIA Resiliency Extension complete-iteration selection. Distinguish worker, host and replica loss; separate local publish, collective completeness, application-state validity and durable recovery.
